name: scholar
_lore_anchor: International scholarly orders practitioner. See worldbuilding/canon/04-cultures-and-traditions.md and worldbuilding/canon/05-magical-practice.md. Combat is substrate-shaping technique, not melee.
_palette: deep navy + off-white + brass instrument accent
_weapon_overlay_note: Per ADR 002 Decision 5, weapons are item overlays rendered at runtime via per-frame weapon-anchor positions. Hands are described as visible/empty so any item can be composed onto them.
description: expedition-attached scholar from international research orders, equipped for fieldwork inside the Tower, intricate detailed pixel art character design, wearing layered field clothing — deep navy outer cloak with hood up showing a thoughtful focused face, off-white undertunic visible at the chest, a leather research apron with brass-fitted pockets across the front, a bandolier across the chest holding small glass specimen vials and rolled parchment notes, sturdy traveling boots, sleeves rolled showing forearms stained from ink and sample work, a small brass-cased lantern hooked at the right hip, a coiled rope at the left hip, both hands clearly drawn and visible at sides (open palms, no items held), cosmopolitan cross-cultural appearance, careful attentive observant posture of someone trained to study what could kill them, viewed from a top-down 3/4 perspective with slight forward tilt, clean readable silhouette

_animation_mapping.lead-jab: attack placeholder — scholar's real attack is substrate-shaping channel; revisit with custom action_description when locked
